Reducers: how an event stream becomes one value per person or episode

Source: R/lang_v2.R
omop_reduce.Rd

The reducer contract (frozen, design section 2.7) fixes for every fn its input, ordering, NULL handling, empty-window value and type. Rows are ordered by (start date, source, row key). A few rules worth knowing: first_value/last_value skip NULL values by default (missing = "keep" selects the row first); count and binary are 0 over an empty window, value reducers NA; covered_days measures the union of the recorded intervals inside the window (never summed durations; observed_only = TRUE intersects it with the observed days, the PDC numerator); supply_days sums days_supply of fills starting in the window (fills = "clipped" clips each fill to the window), the MPR numerator; an undefined anchor gives NA for every reducer.

Usage

omop_reduce(
  fn,
  value = NULL,
  window = NULL,
  which = NULL,
  n = 1L,
  side = c("either", "before", "after"),
  missing = c("skip", "keep"),
  distinct = NULL,
  p = NULL,
  agg = NULL,
  reference = NULL,
  predicate = NULL,
  reference_date = NULL,
  unit = NULL,
  coverage = c("recorded", "effective_supply"),
  fills = c("start_in_window", "clipped"),
  observed_only = FALSE
)

Arguments

fn

Reducer name (see fn in the plan schema).

value

Value column (default: the normalised value for value reducers).

window

NULL or an omop_window().

which

NULL or "first", "last", "nth", "closest".

n

Row number(s) for nth_value (a vector gives suffixed columns).

side

closest_value: "either", "before", "after".

missing

"skip" (default) or "keep" NULL values before selection.

distinct

count: "row", "day", "visit", "concept".

p

Quantile probability in (0, 1].

agg

drug_duration: "mean", "sum", "max".

reference

Anchor for days_since/days_until.

predicate

any/all: an omop_where() predicate.

reference_date

time_since: fixed ISO date (legacy).

unit

time_since: "day" or "month".

coverage

covered_days: "recorded" or "effective_supply" (stockpiled eras only).

fills

supply_days: "start_in_window" or "clipped".

observed_only

covered_days: intersect with observed days.

Value

An omop_reducer object.

Examples

omop_reduce("closest_value", window = omop_window(-180, 0), side = "before")
omop_reduce("covered_days", window = omop_window(1, 90), observed_only = TRUE)
